_about: What each table row does, for the app to apply. The text shown is always the book's (data/generated). Keys are the book's own row labels, so a renamed row fails the tests. Effects: parts, xp, status, next (starts the next battle), tag, contact, rival, rumour, silly, item (gain: key or kinds/source/maxPrice, fit), loseItem, sellItem, buyItem, hire (an offer: discount or free), relicLead, sellerFound, noTasks, noTask, gift, healInjury, prosthetic, allLaidUpToSore, injury, injuryRoll (Light/Heavy list, or glitches for bots), reroll, dead, leave, title, finds, drop, d6, test, choice, recharge (Energy, or 'full'; who), taskPay (0, 0.5, 2 or 'failure'), noFinds, retest, swapAdvance, note. who: self, choose, all, patient, teacher, captain, lowestXp, evacuated, legend, bot, type:<Type>. prize / finalPrize: the battle's prize (9.5) and the Final's (14.13).
